name: granted
description: Review long AI reports like an emperor: one card per decision, answers saved inside one HTML file, versioned rounds until every item is decided.

interface.shortDescription: Rule on long AI reports, one card at a time
interface.longDescription: Turn a long report, or the agent's own work, into a self-saving HTML review form: one card per decision, with evidence, options and a recommendation. The reviewer answers in the browser; the agent reads the answers back and sends a shorter round with only the open items, until every item is decided.
defaultPrompt: Use $granted to turn docs/report.md into a review form.
Give me the result as a Granted review instead of a long report.
I saved the review form: read my answers and start the next round.
